description: The file defines the NodeRuntime class, which manages device gateway connections, gatekeepers, chat, voice, and UI interactions within an Android app. It handles gateway connection logic, session management, UI updates, and event handling for a complex, interactive system.

classes.name: NodeRuntime
classes.description: Main class managing gateway connectivity, sessions, chat, voice, and UI in an Android app.
